summary: Bun runtime with Hono web framework, server-side JSX rendering, HTMX for client interactivity
Server-side rendered HTML via Hono JSX + HTMX 2.0; no client-side framework or SPA
hLedger as single source of truth for positions and cash; SQLite for AI artefacts only
DatabaseFactory singleton enforcing WAL mode, busy timeout, foreign keys; no raw Database() calls
Subprocess bridge (analyze_stream.py) for Python core; never fork tradingagents/ package
JSONL indexes for knowledge management; SQLite reserved for operational data only
